notes.title: ⚙️ General System Adjustments: Patch Stabilization Protocol
notes.notes:
🔬 Infection Protocol Tuning
- 🧪 Aggression Fix Deployed: Enemies now correctly detect infected ships and react with hostile intent. No more passive pirates—infection is officially a battle trigger.
📡 Mission Ops Targeting Correction
- 🎯 Kill Tracking Refined: Mission Ops now enforce precise target identification. Only intended NPCs will count toward objectives—no more workaround eliminations

notes.title: 🛠️ Prep Update
notes.notes:
🔧 Technical Fixes
- Enemy UI Bugs Eliminated: Enemy indicators now respond like clockwork. No more phantom health bars or flickering threat signals.
🌈 Visual Overhaul
- New Ship Shader System: Ships now shimmer with customized effects. 
🧠 AI Innovation
- AI Companion (Early Alpha): Our engineers are forging a next-gen support system to accompany pilots mid-mission. Not operational yet... but she’s watching.
🗺️ System Integration
- Mini Map Upgrade: Navigate free space with confidence. Track, and strategize better than ever.
- Mission Ops Merged with Free Space: Optional tasks now show up as you explore. Big bounties, big payouts—no briefing needed.
🎰 Feature Drop
- Credit Exchange Slot Machine: Burn credits, break limits. Spin for gear, Premium Lite, levels,  and skeleton keys. Luck favors the daring.
📖 Lore & Legacy
- Lore Page Rework In Progress: The archives are shifting—expect deeper history, and strange discoveries.
- Milestone Update Incoming: Rewards are evolving. Soon, achieving greatness will feel even more rewarding.

notes.title: General Update
notes.notes:
[list]Update 1.0.1.1
[*] Code Clean up (Removed code that wasn't being used anymore)
[*] UI Update (User Page UI updated as well as the ship load out page)
[*] Ship loadout changes is prep work for adding new features.
[*] Added .20% to all ships as a base for shield absorption, Increases survivability.
[*] Adjusted a few ship skins that caused FPS to drop by half.
[*] Improved Player's Tab locking (Will now lock the closes target)
[*] Added Q key as an extra key shortcut for starting and canceling combat (More ergonomically friendly on your hands)
[*] Update Hp, Shield Colors to be easier to see well flying around, also updated players lock on NPC's.
Increased text size from 6 to 12 and moved around the wording a little bit so enemy hp, and shields stats is more readable and less smooshed together.
[*] Fixed Issues with resource, and loot spawn location.
[*] Fixed some item Descriptions, (Laser Weapons DMG increased, forgot to adjust the text to reflect the change before the release.)
[*] Fixed Exploit with Scarab ship skin ability making all skeleton chest openable without keys even the treasure hunt event wasn't active. (The perk should only be active during Treasure Hunt event.)
[/list]

[list] Next Update will include

Thank you,
